# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects any active spell or item from the Mentalism realm; caster can
concentrate on a 5' radius area each round.
@@ 2
As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Essence.
@@ 3
As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Channeling.
@@ 4
As Detect Mentalism, except caster can detect extremes of emotion and which
emotions they are (e.g., hatred, love, sadness, etc.). If there are no
extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal feelings), this spell detects nothing.
@@ 5
As Detect Mentalism, except detects all invisible things; all attacks against
something so detected are at -50.
@@ 6
As Detect Mentalism, except detects if a being is evil or an item created by
evil or long used by a very evil person.
@@ 7
As Detect Mentalism, except that it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap
(trap sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance).
@@ 8
As Detect Mentalism, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e.,
level) of the person or item or spell examined.
@@ 10
As Detect Mentalism, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or cast)
and what list is was cast from. In the case of a person it gives the person’s
profession.
@@ 11
As Perceive Power I, except range is 100' and area is 10' radius.
@@ 13
As Detect Invisible, except caster can see invisible things anywhere he can
normally see. In addition, his attacks suffer no penalties against invisible
targets he can see.
@@ 15
As Detect Mentalism, except caster becomes aware of any spells cast in the
area. The caster will know the spell type and the list it was cast from.
@@ 16
As above, except range is 500' and area is 50' radius.
@@ 18
As Power Typing, except exact spell type is known for every spell thrown in
the area.
@@ 20
As above, except range is 1 mile and area of effect is 300' radius.
@@ 25
Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the
caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.
@@ 30
As Detect Mentalism, except any of the lower level “detect” spells can be
used, one per round.
@@ 50
Any or all of the lower level non-Location spells on this list may be used
simultaneously.
